Abebook.title: Virgil's Iliad: An Essay on Epic Narrative
Abebook.subject: Virgil; Aeneid; Homer; Iliad; epic poetry; classical studies; Latin literature; literary criticism; classics; Cambridge University Press
Abebook.description: Cambridge University Press paperback, the 1991 reprint of the 1984 first edition. Trade softcover in navy laminated wrappers with yellow and cream lettering; issued without dust jacket. The wrappers show minor wear, with light rubbing and surface scuffing, a short crease near the head of the front cover, and slight discoloration along the top edge; the page edges are evenly toned. Spine uncreased and unbroken, binding tight, text clean and unmarked throughout. Gransden's study reads Aeneid VII-XII as a continuous epic narrative answering Homer's Iliad, and needs no Latin of its reader.
